rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「지역문화진흥법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Regional Culture Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(지역문화전문인력 양성기관 지정신청서) 「지역문화진흥법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제7조제3항에 따른 지역문화전문인력 양성기관 지정신청서는 별지 제1호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Designation as a Training Institution for Regional Culture Professionals) The application for designation as a training institution for regional culture professionals pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Regional Culture Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(지역문화전문인력 양성기관 지정서) 문화체육관광부장관은 「지역문화진흥법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제10조제2항에 따라 지역문화전문인력 양성기관을 지정하였을 때에는 별지 제2호서식의 지역문화전문인력 양성기관 지정서를 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Designation Certificate for Regional Culture Professional Training Institution) When the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism designates a regional culture professional training institution pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Regional Culture Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), he/she shall issue a designation certificate for a regional culture professional training institution in the form of Annex 2.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(문화도시 지정서) 문화체육관광부장관은 법 제15조제5항에 따라 문화도시를 지정하였을 때에는 별지 제3호서식의 문화도시 지정서를 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Designation Certificate for Cultural City) When the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism designates a cultural city pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 5 of the Act, he/she shall issue a cultural city designation certificate in the form of Annex 3.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism Decree No. 175, July 29, 2014>
This rule shall take effect on July 29, 2014.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <문화체육관광부령 제371호, 2019. 10. 7.> (어려운 법령용어 정비를 위한 18개 법령의 일부개정에 관한 문화체육관광부령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism Decree No. 371, Oct. 7, 2019> (Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism Decree on the Partial Amendment of 18 Laws for the Reorganization of Difficult Legal Terms)
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
